professional_positioning.headline: Civil Engineering Technician & Site Supervision Officer
summary_bullets: 2 years of civil construction supervision, trenching & water-reticulation inspection, and AutoCAD drafting on the Copperbelt.
Experienced with daily site progress logs, materials take-offs, and contractor safety briefings.

seniority.evidence_rationale: 2 years technician & assistant site engineer experience aligns with Junior Engineer, Engineering Technician, Clerk of Works, and Site Assistant roles.

responsibilities: Supervised stormwater drainage, concrete curing checks, and municipal water pipe trench alignments.
Prepared daily site diaries, cement/aggregate consumption logs, and AutoCAD as-built markups.

credential_verification_status.notes: ZAQA verification submitted and awaiting final stamp.

explicit_skills.name: Site Supervision & Concrete Inspection
explicit_skills.evidence_snippet: Supervised stormwater drainage, concrete curing checks

inferred_transferable_skills.inferred_from: Daily materials take-off and site contractor diaries

adjacent_career_paths.why_plausible: Direct site quality logging and drainage/pipe inspection experience.
adjacent_career_paths.required_bridge_or_gap: Active EIZ Technician practicing certificate needed where statutory.

adjacent_career_paths.why_plausible: Hands-on pipe alignment and trenching supervision translates directly to water utilities.

ambiguities_to_confirm.question: Confirm current Engineering Institution of Zambia (EIZ) membership and practicing certificate status.
ambiguities_to_confirm.why_it_matters: EIZ practicing registration is mandatory by Zambian law for engineering roles.
ambiguities_to_confirm.candidate_answer: EIZ Technician application and ZAQA verification both in progress.
